title: FizzBuzz, your way
description:
Print FizzBuzz with `match` on a tuple.

```
1
2
Fizz
4
Buzz
...
14
FizzBuzz
```
hints: `match` is an expression, so each arm can give a `String`: `(0, 0) => "FizzBuzz".to_string(),` (lesson 1.04).
requirements: Count from 1 to 15 (or a number the user types).
stretch: Add "Bazz" for multiples of 7, without writing every combination by hand.
